summary: The PR addresses the issue of creating an empty Array but introduces potential regressions and non-minimal changes.

issues.description: The change may introduce behavioral regressions, such as altering how empty arrays are handled in other parts of the codebase.
The PR includes unrelated changes, such as modifying the `_parse_index` method, which are not directly related to fixing the issue of empty arrays.
The code changes could be made more readable by adding comments explaining the new logic for handling empty arrays.
